initial_application: No local commit message explicitly mentions FHIR-2887. The relevant historical application appears to be commit 5b375304cb, which reworked Profile publication to start using diff/snapshot profiles and added Profile.structure.base wording explaining differential versus snapshot mode, matching Jira comments that the work was completed cumulatively over a three-month period.
additional_context: The old Profile resource has become StructureDefinition in the current build. source/fhir.ini actively lists structuredefinition=StructureDefinition. Current StructureDefinition has type, baseDefinition, derivation, separate snapshot and differential elements, an invariant requiring either a snapshot or a differential, and comments explaining differential structures for editing and snapshot structures for operational use. The $snapshot operation also supports generating a snapshot from a differential.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current source satisfies the old one-resource model with metadata and separate views needed for differential-only, snapshot-only, or combined StructureDefinitions, and extra prose would be redundant.
